description: Compare non-binding quote options for approved merchant SKUs by quantity and destination. Each quantity must be an integer, meet the SKU MOQ, and not exceed confirmed sellable inventory; destination.country must be ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

destination.description: Buyer delivery destination used for shipping estimates.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, such as US or GB.

environment.description: Catalog environment. Only production listings can produce a quote.

items.description: At least one requested line with sku and a positive integer quantity.

quantity.description: Requested units; must meet the product MOQ.

name: compare_quotes

outputSchema.description: Read-only quote comparison. Error objects identify invalid country, SKU, MOQ, inventory or supplier confirmation requirements.
